title: Sectionwise quasi-isomorphisms are quasi-isomorphisms of sheaves with independent coefficient universe
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $R$ a sheaf of rings on it, and $f:K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ a map of cochain complexes of $R$-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. If $\Gamma(U,f)$ is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] of complexes of abelian groups for every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$, then $f$ is a quasi-isomorphism of module-sheaf complexes. This universe-general form takes C : Type u with Category v and coefficient/module universe max u v r, for arbitrary r; assume abelian-group sheafification and its locally bijective characterization on the original site. It uses the same sheaves, restriction, Hom complex, differentials, and induced maps as the original source statement.

proof.text: Work with objects in Type u, arrows in Type v, and coefficient rings and modules in Type (max u v r). Use the existing siteAbelianHasSheafify and siteAbelianWEqualsLocallyBijective instances on the slice whenever an abelian or exactness instance is needed. All these instances are proved, and the given base-site instances are retained.

Forget the module structures and view the complexes as complexes of presheaves of abelian groups. Mathlib HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_iff_evaluation makes the sectionwise hypothesis a quasi-isomorphism of those presheaf complexes. The mapHomologicalComplexCompIso identifies evaluation of a mapped complex with mapping by the section functor.

Exact abelian sheafification preserves this quasi-isomorphism. Its natural counit is an isomorphism on sheaves, so NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex and Arrow.isoOfNatIso identify the sheafified presheaf map with the original map of abelian-sheaf complexes.

The exact module-to-abelian-sheaf forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms. Apply Mathlib HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_map_iff_of_preservesHomology to conclude that the original module-sheaf map is a quasi-isomorphism. The complete Lean proof uses the source library exactness instances for SheafOfModules.toSheaf.

lean.statement: theorem quasiIso_of_sectionsOfUniverses {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C} [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}] {R : Sheaf J RingCat.{max u v r}} {K L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v r} R) ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L) (h : ∀ U : C, QuasiIso (((SheafOfModules.forget R ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation R.obj (op U) ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u v r} (R.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map f)) : QuasiIso f
